title: Single-author public journal with admin posting, media attachments, and II-gated locked posts (frontend)

requirements.summary: Provide an owner-only Admin UI to create, edit, and delete posts, visible only to the configured owner/admin.
acceptanceCriteria: The app has an Admin area/page that is visible/enabled only for the configured owner principal.
Owner can create a new post, edit an existing post, and delete a post from the UI.

file_operations.description: Create an Admin page that uses the authorization component’s role/admin concept by checking backend isCallerAdmin()/getCallerUserRole() before rendering admin controls; include post list with edit/delete actions, and a post create/edit form (title/content/isLocked). Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button, Card, Input, Textarea, Dialog) for the workflow. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a small route/page guard wrapper that renders an English Access Denied state when the viewer is not an admin/owner (based on isCallerAdmin()). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a React Query hook that fetches isCallerAdmin()/getCallerUserRole() via useActor, with loading/error states to support Admin navigation gating and route guard decisions. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the Admin page route into the app, wrap it with AdminRouteGuard, and ensure the Admin link only appears when admin status is true. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a top navigation bar with links to Home and (when admin) Admin, plus the Internet Identity login/logout control; keep text in English and layout responsive. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Gate locked posts behind Internet Identity login with clear locked/not-authorized UI states and re-fetch after login.
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated visitors can view the post list and open free posts fully.
Unauthenticated visitors attempting to open a locked post see a locked state UI and a prompt to sign in with Internet Identity.
After signing in, the app re-attempts to load the locked post content.

file_operations.description: Create a post detail page that loads post metadata and renders free posts fully. For locked posts: if not authenticated show a locked state with an Internet Identity sign-in prompt; if authenticated, attempt to load locked content via backend capability and render it when available, otherwise show a clear English not-authorized state. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement a login/logout control using the authorization component’s Internet Identity flow via useInternetIdentity; on logout, clear React Query cache to remove any gated content from memory. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a React Query hook that conditionally fetches locked content for a post only when authenticated, and exposes loading/error/empty states for the PostDetail page. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the PostDetail page route and ensure navigating to a locked post triggers the locked state UI when unauthenticated. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the auth state transitions are reflected in the UI (e.g., loginStatus) and that pages dependent on authentication can react to identity changes (no UI flash of gated content). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a minimal entitlement (allowlist) management UI for the owner and clear not-authorized messaging for logged-in users.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend provides an owner-only UI to add/remove principals to the allowlist (copy/paste principal text).
Non-allowlisted logged-in users see a clear ‘not subscribed/authorized’ state for locked posts (in English).

file_operations.description: Create an owner-only allowlist management panel with a principal text input and add/remove actions calling backend grantAccess/revokeAccess/hasAccess, with inline English validation/errors. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Input, Button, Card) for layout. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a helper to parse/validate principal text for allowlist operations (returning a user-friendly English error message when invalid). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the AllowlistManager into the Admin page (visible only to admin/owner) and ensure grant/revoke actions show success/error feedback. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

For authenticated users who cannot access a locked post (locked content fetch returns null/error), render a clear English ‘not authorized/not subscribed’ state distinct from the ‘please login’ state. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Support adding image/video attachments to posts in Admin UI and render them responsively in post details, respecting locked gating.
acceptanceCriteria: A post can include multiple media attachments, each typed as either image or video.
The create/edit post UI supports adding media entries.
Post detail view renders image attachments and video attachments appropriately (responsive layout).

file_operations.description: Create a media uploader component for the Admin create/edit form that accepts image/video files, converts them to blob-storage ExternalBlob (from backend bindings) and calls backend addMediaToPost; show upload progress using ExternalBlob.withUploadProgress and English status messaging. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a responsive media gallery renderer that displays image attachments and video attachments using blob-storage ExternalBlob.getDirectURL() (no bytes fetch by default), with a safe layout for mobile/desktop. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Integrate MediaUploader into the post create/edit workflow, allowing multiple attachments per post and showing a list of currently attached media for the post being edited. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Render MediaGallery in the post detail view only when the viewer is allowed to view the post’s full content; for unauthorized locked posts, do not render direct media URLs. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Create public Home/feed and Post Detail pages with navigation and II login/logout control; ensure responsive UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Home/feed page lists posts newest-first with title, date, and a locked indicator for locked posts.
Post detail page shows title, date, body, and media (subject to access rules).
Navigation includes links to Home and (when owner) Admin; and a login/logout control for Internet Identity.
UI is usable on mobile and desktop (responsive layout).

file_operations.description: Create a Home/feed page that fetches posts, sorts newest-first, displays title/date and a locked indicator, and links into the PostDetail page. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card, Badge/Skeleton) for consistent UI. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add React Query hooks for listing posts and fetching a single post using useActor, with proper caching keys and refetching on actor/identity changes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add Home/Admin navigation links and include the AuthButton login/logout control; ensure responsive layout for mobile and desktop. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire HomePage and PostDetailPage into the app’s routing/navigation system, and ensure TopNav is displayed consistently across pages. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Apply a cohesive warm charcoal/cream theme with consistent typography across Home, Post Detail, and Admin, including required logo and background texture assets.
acceptanceCriteria: App uses a distinct, cohesive theme (not blue/purple by default) with consistent spacing, typography, and component styling.
Theme is applied consistently across Home, Post Detail, and Admin pages.
User-facing text is in English.

file_operations.description: Add the generated minimalist wordmark logo asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/logo.dim_512x512.png and ensure it is referenced by the app branding UI.
Add the generated subtle paper-grain background texture at frontend/public/assets/generated/paper-texture.dim_1600x900.png and ensure it is used as part of the app background styling.

Update global styling tokens (CSS variables and Tailwind base styles) to a warm charcoal/cream palette, set readable typography for long-form content, and apply the paper texture as a subtle background. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create an app layout wrapper that applies consistent spacing/typography for journal content, includes the logo from frontend/public/assets/generated/logo.dim_512x512.png in the header, and ensures consistent page framing. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wrap routed pages with AppLayout so the theme/typography is applied consistently across Home, Post Detail, and Admin. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add validation, loading/error/empty states, and content quality constraints across forms and data-fetching views.
acceptanceCriteria: Forms validate required fields (e.g., title/body) and show inline English error messages.
All data-fetching views show loading states and error states.
When there are no posts, Home shows an empty-state message and (for owner) a call-to-action to create the first post.

file_operations.description: Create a small shared component for rendering loading/error/empty states in a consistent English tone (usable by Home, Post Detail, and Admin). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add loading skeletons, error state UI, and an empty-state message; when admin/owner, include a call-to-action link/button to create the first post in Admin. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add loading and error states for both post metadata and locked-content fetch; ensure locked/login/not-authorized states are clearly differentiated in English. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add inline validation for required fields (title/content), disable submit until valid, and show clear English errors for failed save/delete/media upload/allowlist actions. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
